title: CO₂ standards for new heavy goods vehicles
subtitle: Final adoption by qualified majority
voteRuleLabel: Qualified majority (55% of states, 65% of population)
summary: Ministers adopted the regulation requiring a 90% cut in average emissions from new heavy goods vehicles by 2035, against 2019 levels. Six member states voted against and Austria abstained: enough countries to block it, but between them only 30.5% of the population, and a blocking minority needs more than 35%.
whatItMeans: New trucks sold from 2035 must average 90% lower emissions than the 2019 fleet.
A review clause in 2030 can revisit the trajectory but not the end date.
Charging and hydrogen corridor obligations move to a separate infrastructure file, which is where the opposing states say the real cost sits.

outcome.headline: Adopted — the states opposing it had the numbers but not the population.
